caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped wooden table with six straight, tapered legs. The table surface and legs are predominantly colored in shades of brown, suggesting a wood grain texture, with lighter and darker streaks. Ornamental details in green and yellow are present along the edges of the table and on the legs, with oval decorative medallions on the corners of the apron connecting the legs. The legs are further detailed with green and yellow elongated lined patterns, and there are reinforced bands at the feet. To the left of the main image, there is a vertical close-up segment illustrating the design on a single leg, showing a medallion with a floral motif near the top, a tapered longitudinal pattern below, and additional green and yellow details. The entire composition is set against a plain, beige background with a thin rectangular border around the scene.
title: Dining Table
